title: FloodAlertIssued
description: Emitted by a flood module when a gauge crosses warning/danger thresholds or a forecast indicates imminent flooding.

x-envelope.severity_mapping: level>=danger → emergency; level>=warning → warning; level>=0.85*warning → watch; else advisory
x-envelope.geometry: GeoJSON Polygon of estimated inundation extent (events.geom_geojson)
